record.one_liner: Copper is a CRM for small and mid-size businesses, built around Google Workspace, that manages leads, contacts, companies, opportunities, projects and tasks.
record.auth_notes: API key is generated in the Copper web app (System settings > API Keys). It is sent in the X-PW-AccessToken header, together with X-PW-Application: developer_api and X-PW-UserEmail (the key owner's email). The auth page lists OAuth 2.0 as the preferred method for partner integrations. I could not fetch the OAuth detail pages (the overview URL returned 404), so I did not verify the flow or any app registration requirements.
record.access_notes: Unverified. The fetched developer docs do not state any plan requirement or free tier. Copper has no documented free plan or free developer sandbox, and I did not fetch the pricing page. A secondary source (Numerics) says the integration works on Professional and Business plans, which suggests a paid account. The docs say admins can see and generate tokens. Whether non-admin users can create keys is unclear. Treat the cheapest path as a paid account or trial, and confirm on the pricing page.
record.blocker: Rate limit of 180 requests/min (bulk APIs also capped at 3 requests/sec). API keys are per-user and require the owner's email header. Plan or tier needed for API access is not documented in the pages I fetched. OAuth details unverified. The docs say they cover "most" resources, not all.
